Sales Associate (Part-Time)
Northwind Outdoor Supply · Seattle, WA – Capitol Hill store

What you'll do: greet customers, help them find the right gear, run the register and keep the sales floor looking great.

You'll be a great fit if you have:
- A passion for customer service
- Experience with cash handling and POS systems
- Availability on weekends and holidays
- Prior retail experience preferred, but not required
- Bilingual in Spanish is a plus

Perks: 40% employee discount, flexible scheduling, paid time off for part-timers, 401(k) after 90 days.

Northwind is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. No degree needed – just bring your enthusiasm.
Apply in store or at jobs@northwind-outdoor.example
